notes: Direct tuning rows that can drive Year Zero generation.
Weighted choices used by generation logic. Validate weight groups before sampling.
Numeric or categorical modifiers used after base records are selected.
Rules that enforce eligibility, caps, conversion, accounting, or selection.
Definitions and taxonomy records. Can be used by runtime selectors, but should not be treated as weighted choices unless a source_table-specific rule says so.
Balance targets and guardrails. Use for validation, reporting, and caps only. Do not sample players directly from these rows.
Explicit validation pass/fail targets. Never use as generation weights.
Implementation guide rows. Do not load into player generation state.
Examples and debug scenarios. Use only for docs, UI mockups, and tests after final phase.
Research-source notes. Do not affect runtime gameplay.
Debug/export schema rows. Use only for debug output shape.
